verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I love bananas
I know that mangoes are sweet

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I love papayas (woah!)
I know that nothing can beat
The sweet sweet love of God

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
They are new every morning
New every morning

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Great is thy faithfulness, O Lord
Great is thy faithfulness

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases
His mercies never come to an end
